answer_1.quote: Our approach is anchored around three core categories of NLG tasks: dialogue, summarization, and data-to-text.

answer_2.quote: We compare our X‑EVAL with the following state‑of‑the‑art NLG evaluation metrics: (1) UniEval … (4) ROUGE‑L ; (5) DynaEval ; (6) BERTScore ; (7) Mover‑Score ; (8) USR ; (9) BARTScore.

answer_3.quote: X‑EVAL follows a two‑stage training paradigm … we first instruction‑finetune an open‑source language model to equip it with the capability of following human‑written instructions for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: For text summarization, we adopt SummEval … which contains human ratings of 100 summaries along four evaluation dimensions: fluency, coherence, consistency, and relevance. Topical‑Chat … human ratings … assess five aspects: naturalness, coherence, engagingness, groundedness, and understandability.
